Multi-line See Also Links

The purpose of this test is to verify that the \sa command supports multi-line link syntax, where the link target and link text can be on different lines. This matches the documented behavior that \sa supports the same kind of links as \l.

Test Cases

This page tests multi-line \sa syntax where {target} and {text} are on separate lines, which should work just like it does with \l.

See also Link text on the next line.
